name: expertise-miner
description: Build a searchable corpus of YouTube transcripts for a channel, a playlist or a video, then mine it for an expert's research questions, rules of thumb and research steps. Every mined item carries a quote that was checked word for word against the stored transcript, the video and the moment it was said, and a way to test it against data. Slow and polite by default; local SQLite storage, MongoDB optional. Search is by words; search by meaning is an optional extra through an embeddings endpoint you set yourself.
